collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQA 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQA 2020 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and an 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this EQA which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
